note: Stage 3B replaces the 11 remaining stub query services with real DB-backed reads (apps/server/src/desktop/queries/domains.ts) and rebinds the 15 remaining renderer screens via useDesktopData + StateFrame. All 19 desktop screens now consume authoritative server data across the authenticated desktop.data IPC channel. Every screen renders all 10 required states via the shared StateFrame component; the 150-assertion state matrix (apps/desktop/tests/renderer/stage3b_state_matrices.test.tsx) is the machine-checked proof. Native Electron integration test, deterministic report generation, managed-Docker runtime verification, and Windows packaging remain out of scope for Stage 3B.
authenticationReason: apps/desktop/src/main/index.ts defaults authenticationRequired=true in packaged builds; the desktop.data channel is on the IPC_ALLOWLIST with requiresAuthenticatedSession=true; Stage 2-FIX 103-assertion privileged-IPC matrix continues to pass; server-side operatorProcedure classifies every desktop.* procedure as operator_authenticated_business (verified by Stage 2-FIX inventory audit + Stage 3A-FIX read-only-boundary test, which continues to pass in Stage 3B against domains.ts).

countReconciliation.domainsVsScreensNote: 18 domains vs 19 screens because 'incidents' is one domain with two procedures (list + acknowledge) but appears as a single Incidents screen, and because 'positions' is one domain producing both the Positions list screen and its detail view.
